question: Which requirements must be met in order to perform transaction log backups for a database on a Microsoft SQL Server with Veeam Backup & Replication? (Choose the 2 appropriate options) A. The recovery model for the database must be set to Simple. B. The recovery model for the database must be set to Full or Bulk-Logged. C. No other backup tool truncates the SQL server’s log files. D. The database must have its log flies on a separate VMDK.

At least two - one at the production site and one at the remote site D. Veeam Data Mover services are not required to transfer data offsite

Forward incremental backup with synthetic fulls with transform to rollbacks D. Forward incremental backup

After you selected Incremental mode in the job settings, how do you ensure the forever forward incremental backup mode is configured? A. Check the "Use Forever Forward Incremental" box B. Synthetic fulls impose less load on the production environment.

Analyzes the system, installs and upgrades necessary components and services depending on the role selected for the server B.
